'''Knife Man''' is an enemy in '''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''.

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:KnifeManNES1.png|80px]]

A Knife Man is first encountered in [[Galesburg|Act 1-1]]. They slowly march in one direction, just like a [[Biker]] would. If left alone for a couple seconds, they will throw a knife in a straight line towards [[Ryu Hayabusa|Ryu]]. They only deal 1 point of damage on contact, but their knife does 2 points of damage. They are easily defeated in one hit by any attack, and their knives can be destroyed as well.
